verdict.rationale: Muse is built around chat: first-party docs say users just tell Muse what they want done in the app, on Mac, or in WhatsApp, with no learning curve. Users can also manage goals and tasks by talking to it in chat. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of how broadly natural-language commands control product features (e.g., settings, permissions) beyond task requests.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: There's no learning curve, just tell Muse what you want to get done.
Chat with your agent in the same way you message with other people, using the Muse app on mobile, Mac, or directly in WhatsApp.
you can interact directly there or talk to it about these tasks in chat.
Anyone can use it out of the box, no technical experience required.
